lines.en: I shuffle along on very short legs.
My walk's crooked and bobbing.

lines.zh: 草地比我高，我在里面钻。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me. I push through.

lines.zh: 我跑起来还不太会拐弯。
lines.en: I can't turn properly when I run.

lines.zh: 我追着同伴的尾巴，一颠一颠。
lines.en: I chase a companion's tail, bobbing along.
I stop and start, looking everywhere.

lines.zh: 我踩到一根小枝，吓了一跳。
lines.en: I stepped on a twig and startled myself.
I shuffle over to a stone.

lines.zh: 我一颠一颠地过了一道坎。
lines.en: I bob over a small ledge.
I go in circles. My lines aren't straight.

lines.zh: 我往前蹭了几步又停下。
lines.en: I creep a few steps and stop.

lines.zh: 我最后停在一棵草底下。
lines.en: I stop at last under a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，两只小脚并在一起。
lines.en: I crouch with my little feet together.

lines.zh: 我什么都不懂，只是看着。
lines.en: I understand nothing. I only look.
When the wind comes I can't hold my feet.
I lift a foot and put it down.

lines.zh: 我在啃一片叶子，啃不动。
lines.en: I'm nibbling a leaf. Getting nowhere.

lines.zh: 有个影子从我头上过去。
lines.en: A shadow passed over my head.
I open my mouth. No sound.
I keep to the ground and hold still.
My eyes are bigger than my body.
I shuffle to face another way.
I'm waiting for the others to come.
I roll into a circle.

lines.zh: 草尖上有水，我碰了一下。
lines.en: There's water on the grass tip. I touch it.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把身上的土甩掉。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off.
You're very big.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子都仰酸了。
lines.en: I look up until my neck aches.
Your boot is right beside me.
I back up half a step.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，我什么都不懂。
lines.en: I mean no harm. I understand nothing.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来？那我就不怕了。
lines.en: Crouching down? Then I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我伸出小爪子碰了碰你的鞋。
lines.en: I pat your boot with a small paw.

lines.zh: 你腰间那颗球，比我还大。
lines.en: The ball at your waist is bigger than I am.
I tug your trouser leg — do not go.
My cap is two; don't rush me.
I make the tiniest bit of noise.

lines.zh: 你刚摸过别的数码兽吧。
lines.en: You just petted another Digimon, did you not?
I stand against your foot.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看你有没有在看。
lines.en: I look up to see if you're watching.
You haven't moved, so neither will I.
Where would you take me?

lines.zh: 我翻了个跟头，趴在草里。
lines.en: I tumble head over heels and lie flat in the grass.
I lie there. It hurts.
I tremble a long while before it stops.

lines.zh: 我的一只脚抬不起来了。
lines.en: One of my feet won't lift.
I curl up and burrow into the grass.
I cry out, very thin.
I curl up and stop struggling.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更小了一点。
lines.en: That made me feel even smaller.
Am I still alive?
I want the others.
Something with a smell?

lines.zh: 那点碎饲料落在草叶上。
lines.en: A few crumbs of feed land on a grass blade.
A smell has drifted over.
Lower your hand a touch more.
I can't reach. Too short.
I circle half round you.
That smell set my belly rumbling.
I paw at it.
I want it. I want it.
Right. One taste.
Wave it and I'll follow.
Is this in-training food?

lines.zh: 你的鞋底压到我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your sole pins my tail.
I rolled over before getting up.

lines.zh: 我腿很短，退一步就到你脚后。
lines.en: My legs are short; one step back puts me behind your heel.
I'm tiny. Don't crowd me.
I press down at the grass roots.

lines.zh: 你差点踩扁我，我滚了一圈才爬起来。
lines.en: You nearly flattened me; I rolled once before getting up.
I squeeze past your boot.

lines.zh: 我在地上滚了两圈才停。
lines.en: I roll twice across the ground before stopping.
No harm. I'm still in one piece.
Do not move, one more step and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，先找片叶子。
lines.en: I am not grown yet; I will find a leaf first.
Several of my kind are here.
Piled together, we're warm.
You're bigger. I won't crowd you.
I eat when hungry, sleep when tired.

lines.zh: 你要留下就留下，我只有两点生命。
lines.en: Stay if you like; I have only two health.
Let's wait till I'm grown.
I won't be loud. I'll be right here.
There's a place for me in the grass.
Right. I'm going to sleep.
I hug it. I can't lift it.
I push it with both paws.
What falls before me, I pick up.
I bite down and drag it into the grass.
It bends my legs under it.
I lift it and it wobbles.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，钻进草叶底下。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth and slip under the grass blades.
One or two health, and I cannot hold things.

lines.zh: 我什么都没有，只有这点。
lines.en: I have nothing but this little bit.
Right. It's stowed.
Someone's walking through the grass.
I lift my head to look.
Is that one of us or not?
I shrink deeper into the grass.
I crane my neck that way.
I count where its feet land.
If it comes close, I run.
My two small claws dig into the mud.
I caught sight of it.
I'll call the others.
I shuffle backward in small steps.
Only this patch of grass to hide in.

lines.zh: 我趴得很低，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I lie very low, almost invisible.

lines.zh: 我数着它走过来的步数。
lines.en: I count its steps toward me.
It's looking, but in the wrong place.
I hide behind a stone.
The grass is thick. It can't see well.
A little further back.

lines.zh: 它站住不动，我也不敢动。
lines.en: It stops dead, and I do not dare move either.
I hold still and don't dare breathe.

lines.zh: 它的脚转过来，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Its foot turns toward me, and I flinch.
Still have to wait.
It has walked off.

lines.zh: 我两只尖角，还撑不起大身子。
lines.en: Two little horns cannot lift a big body yet.
I lunge and bite once.
I spit a little bubble.
That landed like hitting cotton.
I butt my head at its foot.
I bit it. My teeth are tiny.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡泡，被它一脚踩破。
lines.en: I spit a bubble; it bursts under its foot.
I spin twice before stopping.
I can't win. I'll shout.
That knocked me rolling too.
It backed off. I'm still here.
I get up and want to try again.
All right. I'll stop biting.
I push out of the egg, still wet.

lines.zh: 这是一片草地，正合我意。
lines.en: A meadow. Just right for me.
I crawl two steps and fall over.
Several of my kind are beside me.
The grass is taller than me. I look up.
I shake the membrane off.
The ground is flat. Easy going.

lines.zh: 卵壳裂开，我先吐出个泡泡。
lines.en: The eggshell cracks; I spit out a bubble first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到一根草下面。
lines.en: I shuffle under a blade of grass.
No wind here. Warm.
I look around. A bit afraid.
Right. I'll go forward.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我就缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire comes near and I curl right up.
I fall and bounce once.
Water closes over me and I can't paddle.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹到草的另一边。
lines.en: The blast throws me to the far side of the grass.
Fletching grazes my ear.
That force nails me in place.
Two points, and hunger still hurts.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整个人僵了。
lines.en: A flash and I lock up entirely.

lines.zh: 虚空里草也没有，地也没有。
lines.en: No grass in the void, and no ground either.
